correctness.rationale: The 4D nondegenerate alternating F3 form yields exactly 40 projective points and 40 totally isotropic lines, each with four incidences; the incidence graph has diameter four. For ordered point–line endpoints at distances 1 and 3, independently enumerated all length-five magnitude chains in degrees 2,3,4 and built the smooth-interior-deletion mod-two boundary matrices. At distance 1, chain dimensions (18,81,120) and ranks (18,63) give H3=0; at distance 3, dimensions (28,87,72) and ranks (28,50) give H3=9. Every degree-four column satisfies ∂3∂4=0 and ranks were computed by exact bit elimination. Explicit symplectic transvection generators act transitively on all 160 incident and 1440 nonincident ordered point-to-line pairs; reversal covers line-to-point. Bipartite length parity makes same-part chains vanish. Thus 2×1440×9=25920. The finite graph enumeration is exhaustive by exact group orbits, not an unjustified sample or an all-q extrapolation.
